blocks.text: CARACAS — Former political prisoners of Venezuela’s Rodeo I are unable to shake the memories of punishments dealt out by hooded jailers in the country’s most notorious prison. The maximum security facility, one of four towers that make up El Rodeo prison on the outskirts of Caracas, is reserved exclusively for opponents of the government.
